_source: Lifted from apps/api/src/modules/astrology/astrology.service.ts — the detectDoshas() output plus the fallback block in getDosha(). Each row carries the canonical English dosha name and its 4-item remedy recommendation list. Descriptions are not stored here — they come from kb_briefing_phrases templates keyed dosha.{key}.{branch} (absent / cancelled_exalted / cancelled_jupiter / present / severe_suffix / birth_required / template) because they interpolate chart-specific placeholders. Nadi carries an empty remedies list — detection is matching-specific, not standalone. English only at seed time; 11 other locales filled by `npm run kb:backfill`.

en.name: Mangal Dosha (Manglik)
remedies: Perform Mangal Shanti Puja on Tuesdays
Wear red coral gemstone (consult astrologer first)

en.name: Kaal Sarp Dosha
remedies: Perform Kaal Sarp Dosha Nivaran Puja at Trimbakeshwar
Chant Rahu Beej Mantra on Saturdays
Donate black sesame seeds on Saturdays
Worship Lord Shiva with Abhishekam on Mondays

en.name: Nadi Dosha
remedies: Perform Maha Mrityunjaya Jaap before marriage
Offer prayers at a Shiva temple on Mondays
Consult an astrologer for Nadi-compatibility-specific remedies
Donate milk and white items on Mondays

en.name: Pitra Dosha
remedies: Perform Pitra Shanti Puja on Amavasya
Offer Tarpan for ancestors during Pitru Paksha
Donate food to Brahmins on Saturdays
Plant a Peepal tree and water it regularly
